# pmon_role (Resource)

An access-control role.

A role is only a name Cedar can match on: it grants nothing by itself. Policies decide what holding it means, and `pmon_group_roles` or `pmon_role_assignment` decide who holds it.

Shipped `system:` roles are immutable and cannot be managed here.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pmon_role" "service_alpha" {
  name        = "service:alpha"
  description = "Entitlement to reach the alpha service datasources"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Role name, as Cedar policies refer to it: `Role::"<name>"`. Renaming updates the role in place, so policies naming the old value stop matching.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What holding the role means. Shown in pmon's console.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) pmon's internal id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Roles are name-keyed, so the name is the whole import id.
terraform import pmon_role.service_alpha 'service:alpha'
```
